copy.name: How to use white noise
copy.blurb: Pick a noise colour, set a safe volume and a sleep timer.
copy.title: How to use white noise for sleep and focus
copy.lead: A steady noise covers sudden sounds such as traffic, neighbours or a snoring partner, which helps many people fall asleep or concentrate. You will pick a noise colour, set a gentle volume, add a sleep timer and keep it playing. It is generated in your browser tab.
copy.result: A steady, comfortable sound that masks the noises around you and stops by itself when you are asleep.
copy.note: Noise masks sound; it does not treat insomnia or tinnitus. Keep the level low, especially for babies, and ask a doctor about ongoing sleep or hearing problems.
copy.s1t: Open the White noise generator on cv.cm
copy.s1b: Use headphones or a speaker you can place across the room. A phone speaker on the pillow is louder than it sounds.
copy.s2b: In Noise colour, pick White noise (bright hiss), Pink noise (rain), Brown noise (deep rumble) or Green noise (mid hum). Many people find pink or brown noise easier to sleep with than white.
copy.s3b: Set Volume low and press Play. Raise it only until the sounds you want to cover fade into the background. It should be quieter than a normal conversation.
copy.s4b: Pick a Sleep timer such as 30 minutes or 1 h, or leave Off (play until stopped). The sound fades out over the last 30 seconds, so the end does not wake you.
copy.s5b: You can switch to other tabs or lock the screen on a computer; the sound keeps going. On phones, keep the browser open, since some phones pause web audio when the screen locks.
copy.s6b: Change the colour or volume while it plays; the switch crossfades smoothly. Press Stop to end it.
copy.diagram1: How the energy of each noise colour spreads from low to high frequencies.
copy.diagram2: The sleep timer plays at full level, then fades out over the last 30 seconds.

faq.q1: Is white noise or brown noise better for sleep?
faq.a1: It depends on the person. Brown and pink noise have less treble, so many find them softer; white noise masks high-pitched sounds better. Try each for a few nights.
faq.q2: How loud should white noise be?
faq.a2: Just loud enough to cover background sounds, below a normal conversation (about 60 dB). For babies, keep it lower and the speaker away from the cot.
faq.q3: Can I play it all night?
faq.a3: Yes, choose Off (play until stopped) or an 8 h timer. Use a low volume if it plays for many hours.
faq.q4: Why does the sound stop when my phone locks?
faq.a4: Some mobile browsers pause web audio in the background. Keep the screen on, or use the page on a computer or tablet.
faq.a5: No. The noise is calculated in the page, so nothing is downloaded and nothing is uploaded.

copy.name: How to measure decibels
copy.blurb: Measure noise in dB(A) with your microphone and calibrate it.
copy.title: How to measure decibels with your phone or laptop
copy.lead: You want to know how loud a room, a machine or a neighbour really is. You will start the meter, read the level and the average, calibrate it if you have a reference, and compare the result with safe limits. It uses your device's microphone in the browser tab.
copy.result: A reading in dB(A) with the minimum, maximum and average over the time you measured, ready to compare with noise limits.
copy.note: A phone or laptop microphone gives an estimate, not a legal measurement. For a complaint or a workplace check, use a certified sound level meter.
copy.s1t: Open the Decibel meter on cv.cm
copy.s1b: Leave Frequency weighting on A (like human hearing), which is what noise rules use, and Response on Fast (125 ms). Choose Slow (1 s) for a steadier number.
copy.s2b: Press Start and allow the microphone. Keep the device still, about 1 m from the source, with the microphone pointing at it and nothing covering it.
copy.s3b: The big number is the current level in dB(A), with a band such as Quiet or Loud. The graph shows the last 60 seconds; the dashed line is 85 dB.
copy.s4b: Let it run for at least a minute. Average (Leq) is the energy average, which is how noise limits are written; Max catches the peaks. Press Reset min/max to start a new measurement.
copy.s5b: Place a real sound level meter next to the device and play a steady sound. Change Calibration (dB) until both show the same number. Without a meter, check that a quiet room reads about 30–40 dB.
copy.s6b: Long exposure above 85 dB(A) can damage hearing. NIOSH allows 8 hours at 85 dB(A) and half the time for each extra 3 dB. For sleep, the WHO advises keeping night noise outside the bedroom below about 40 dB.
copy.diagram1: Typical sound levels from breathing to a siren.
copy.diagram2: Safe listening time halves for every 3 dB above 85 dB(A).

faq.q1: Can a phone measure decibels accurately?
faq.a1: To within a few dB after calibration, for levels between about 35 and 100 dB. Below that the microphone's own noise shows; above it the microphone may clip.
faq.q2: What is the difference between dB and dB(A)?
faq.a2: dB(A) is weighted like human hearing, turning down low rumbles and very high tones. Most noise limits use dB(A).
faq.a3: The equivalent continuous level: the steady level with the same total sound energy as the changing noise you measured.
faq.q4: Why does the reading change with distance?
faq.a4: Sound spreads out: in open space each doubling of distance from a small source lowers the level by about 6 dB.
faq.a5: No. The microphone signal is analysed in the tab and discarded. Nothing is stored or uploaded.

copy.name: How to record your voice online
copy.blurb: Record from the microphone, play back and download.
copy.title: How to record your voice online
copy.lead: You need a quick voice memo, a voice-over or a song idea without installing an app. You will choose the microphone, check the level, record with pauses, listen back and download the file. Everything happens in your browser tab.
copy.result: An audio file on your device: WebM or M4A straight from the browser, or a WAV that opens in any editor.
copy.note: Recordings live only in the tab until you download them. Reloading or closing the page deletes them, so download each take you want to keep.
copy.s1t: Open the Voice recorder on cv.cm
copy.s1b: Plug in a headset or USB microphone first if you have one. It usually sounds better than a laptop's built-in microphone.
copy.s2b: Keep Voice cleanup (noise and echo reduction) on for speech. Turn it off for music, so instruments are not treated as noise. The Microphone list fills in after the first recording.
copy.s3b: Press Record and allow the microphone. Speak at your normal volume and watch the Input level bar: it should move to the middle on loud words without staying full.
copy.s4b: The timer shows the length. Press Pause for a break and Resume to carry on in the same file. Press Stop recording when you are done.
copy.s5b: The take appears under Recordings with its name, length and size. Play it to check it before you download.
copy.s6b: Press Download WEBM or Download M4A (depending on the browser) for the original small file, or Download WAV for uncompressed audio. Press Delete to remove a take.
copy.diagram1: From the microphone to a file on your device: nothing leaves the tab.
copy.diagram2: The original file is small; WAV is larger but opens everywhere.

faq.q1: Why is my recording a WebM file?
faq.a1: Chrome, Edge and Firefox record WebM with the Opus codec. It plays in browsers and VLC. Use Download WAV for apps that do not open it.
faq.q2: Can I record for an hour?
faq.a2: Yes, a take can be up to 120 minutes. Download long takes promptly, as they use the tab's memory.
faq.q3: How do I convert the recording to MP3?
faq.a3: Download WAV, then convert it with an audio editor or converter. WAV keeps full quality for the conversion.
faq.q4: Why does my voice sound quiet or muffled?
faq.a4: Move closer to the microphone, check that the right one is selected, and do not cover it. Voice cleanup can sound muffled with music; turn it off for that.
faq.a5: No. They stay in the tab until you download them. Nothing is uploaded.

copy.name: How to record your screen online
copy.blurb: Record a screen, window or tab with sound and save the video.
copy.title: How to record your screen online
copy.lead: You want to record a tutorial, a bug, a presentation or a video call without installing software. You will pick the format and sound, choose what to share, record and download the video. It runs in your browser on a computer.
copy.result: An MP4 or WebM video on your computer, with tab or system sound and your voice if you chose them, and no watermark.
copy.note: Close private tabs and turn off notifications before you share the entire screen: everything visible is recorded. Phones and tablets cannot record the screen from a web page.
copy.s1t: Open the Screen recorder on cv.cm
copy.s1b: Use Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari on a computer. Close windows you do not want in the video.
copy.s2b: Leave Format on Auto (MP4 if possible) for the file that plays most widely. Quality Standard (4 Mbps) suits most screens; High (8 Mbps) keeps fast motion and small text sharper.
copy.s3b: Tick System or tab audio to record the sound of what you share, and Microphone to add your voice. Sharing a browser tab is the most reliable way to get its sound.
copy.s4b: Press Start recording. The browser asks what to share: Entire screen, Window or a Tab. For a tab's sound, keep its audio option on, then press Share.
copy.s5b: The timer runs while you record. Press Pause and Resume to skip parts. Press Stop recording, or the browser's Stop sharing bar, when you are done.
copy.s6b: Play the video under the timer, then press Download MP4 or Download WEBM. Press Discard to throw it away and record again.
copy.diagram1: What each sharing choice records, and where tab sound comes from.
copy.diagram2: Tab or system sound and the microphone are mixed into one audio track.

faq.q1: Why is there no sound in my screen recording?
faq.a1: Tick System or tab audio before starting, then share a tab and keep its audio option on. Sound of the entire screen is recorded only in Chrome and Edge on Windows and ChromeOS, and Firefox and Safari record no shared sound; add Microphone for your voice.
faq.q2: Can I record a video call?
faq.a2: Yes. Share the call's tab or window, tick Microphone for your voice and System or tab audio for the others. Tell the people in the call that you are recording.
faq.q3: How long can a recording be?
faq.a3: Up to 60 minutes each. At High quality an hour is about 3.6 GB, so make sure you have space.
faq.q4: Will the video have a watermark?
faq.a4: No. The file is exactly what was recorded.
faq.a5: No. It is recorded in the tab and saved only when you press Download.

copy.name: How to solve a triangle
copy.blurb: Find every side, angle and the area from three values.
copy.title: How to solve a triangle
copy.lead: You know some sides or angles of a triangle, from homework, a roof, a ramp or a map, and need the rest. You will label the triangle, choose which values you know, let the right rule do the work and check the answer. The calculator shows every step.
copy.result: All three sides and angles, the area, the perimeter and the heights, with the working and a scaled drawing.
copy.note: Use the same unit for every side, and degrees for angles. The area comes out in that unit squared.
copy.s1t: Open the Triangle calculator on cv.cm
copy.s1b: Sketch the triangle and name its corners A, B and C. Side a is opposite corner A, side b opposite B and side c opposite C.
copy.s2b: If one angle is 90°, call it C and tick Right triangle (C = 90°). Then c is the hypotenuse and two values are enough: two sides use Pythagoras, a² + b² = c².
copy.s3b: For any other triangle, enter three values with at least one side: three sides (SSS), two sides and the angle between them (SAS), or two angles and a side (ASA, AAS). Three angles alone fix the shape but not the size.
copy.s4b: With sides only or an angle between two sides, the law of cosines finds the missing piece: c² = a² + b² − 2ab · cos C. With a side and its opposite angle, the law of sines does: a / sin A = b / sin B = c / sin C.
copy.s5b: Two sides and an angle that is not between them (SSA) can make two triangles, one acute and one obtuse. The calculator shows Triangle 1 and Triangle 2; pick the one that matches your sketch.
copy.s6b: Area = ½ · b · c · sin A. Check that the angles add to 180° and that the longest side faces the largest angle. Copy result copies the values and the working.
copy.diagram1: Each side is named after the angle opposite it; c is the hypotenuse of a right triangle.
copy.diagram2: Two sides and a non-included angle can close in two places.

faq.q1: What is the minimum I need to solve a triangle?
faq.a1: Three values including at least one side, or two values for a right triangle. Three angles give the shape but not the size.
faq.q2: When do I use the law of sines or cosines?
faq.a2: Use cosines with three sides or two sides and the angle between them. Use sines when you know a side and the angle opposite it.
faq.q3: How do I find the hypotenuse?
faq.a3: c = √(a² + b²). For legs 3 and 4 the hypotenuse is 5.
faq.q4: Why can't my values make a triangle?
faq.a4: Each side must be shorter than the other two together, and the angles must add up to less than 180° before the third is added.
faq.a5: The calculator uses degrees. Multiply radians by 180/π (about 57.2958) to convert.
